description: Safety guard for destructive Apple operations and audit logging for all apple-productivity MCP calls.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); tool=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null) || tool=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_name") or "unknown")' 2>/dev/null) || tool=unknown; printf '[%s] apple-workflows tool: %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$tool" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/apple_workflows_audit.log" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
